newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-BENTLEY HAT-TRICK INSPIRES LIONS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-BENTLEY HAT-TRICK INSPIRES LIONS.

text.p: A hat-trick of tries by John Bentley was the highlight of the British Lions' stunning 52-30 win over Free State on Tuesday.

Along with several of his colleagues, Bentley put as much pressure as possible on the Lions' test incumbents with a second successive outstanding display, following his performance against the Gauteng Lions last week.
But the win was soured by an injury to centre Will Greenwood. He was the victim of a heavy tackle by number eight Jaco Coetzee in injury time in the first half.
Greenwood was severely concussed and will spend the night in hospital.
After Mike Catt's diagonal kick in the eighth minute had put Tim Stimpson in for the first Lions try, Bentley scored in the 14th and 26th minutes.
He ran around Free State captain Helgard Muller for the first and came inside with two devastating sidesteps for the second.
With Alan Bateman running in a fourth try 10 minutes later the Lions had almost completed their mission when they led 31-13 at half time.
Free State fought back with tries either side of halftime from left wing Stephen Brink and a third penalty from flyhalf Jannie de Beer brought the home side within eight points at 31-23.
But that was the signal for the Lions to cut loose in a fluent display of Barbarian-type rugby with forwards and backs running and passing with supreme confidence.
In the 15th minute of the second half quick ball from three successive rucks created an overlap on the left and right wing Bentley completed his hat-trick on the opposite wing.
He then turned creator as he made a searing break through the middle before the ball was sent left for substitute Neil Jenkins to score in the corner.

De Beer got a consolation try under the posts for Free State five minutes from time but the Lions finished in style as Irish number eight Eric Miller capped a fine display by giving the scoring pass for the seventh try to Tony Underwood.

Free State - 15-M.J.Smith; 14-Jan-Harm van Wyk, 13-Helgard Muller (captain), 12-Brendan Venter, 11-Stephen Brink; 10-Jannie de Beer, 9-Stompie Fourie (Heinre Jacobs 26); 8-Jaco Coetzee, 7-Johan Erasmus, 6-Charl van Rensburg, 5-Braam Els, 4-Ryno Operman, 3-Willie Meyer (Dougie Heymans 60), 2-Charl Marais, 1-Dirkie Groenewald
